quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but there is heavy traffic coming toward you. What should you do?

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn now because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, wait for the traffic to pass. You can enter the intersection to prepare for your left turn if the light is green and no other vehicle ahead of you is also turning left.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same while on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic while on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until after you move onto the exit ramp.

questions.question: When exiting a highway, when should you slow down?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Get into the exit lane well in advance. Do not slow down until after you have moved into the exit lane.

questions.question: You should leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped:
questions.correctAnswerText: On a hill going upward.
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an upward slope. If the vehicle in front rolls backward when traffic starts moving, there is less chance of a collision.

questions.question: How much alcohol does the body process in one hour?
questions.correctAnswerText: About one drink.
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one alcoholic drink in one hour. However, how impaired a person becomes depends on many factors, including how much alcohol they drink, how fast they drink it, their body weight, how much food they ate, and their general health.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: A driver's left arm and hand extended downward means the driver plans to stop. Adjust your driving if you see this signal from the driver ahead of you.

questions.question: How should you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use the inside rearview mirror only.
Use the outside rearview mirror only.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before you change lanes.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances to help drivers.
questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to specific places. They are useful when driving in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay for other drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, your vehicle must move completely into the left lane.
Motorcycle brake lights always turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, your vehicle must move completely into the left lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use a full lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle on the left.

questions.question: If a green arrow turns into a solid green light, what should you do?

options.text: You may turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
You must go straight and cannot turn.
You still have the right-of-way to turn.
You no longer need to turn in the direction the arrow pointed.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you can still turn in the direction the arrow pointed. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
An area only for motor vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large truck or vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is the blind spot area around large trucks and vehicles. Drivers should not stay in these areas because the truck driver cannot see them.

questions.question: If your vehicle has Anti-Lock Brakes and starts to lose traction on a slippery road, what should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
Press and hold the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
questions.explanation: Press the brake pedal hard and hold it down. The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) will pump the brakes automatically, faster than you could do it. If you pump the brakes or release pressure, the ABS will not work properly.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You may pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You may pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You may pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When are roads most slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining for an hour or more
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain
questions.explanation: Roads become very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. This happens because rain brings oil from the asphalt to the road surface. Hot weather makes this worse.

questions.question: What shape and color is a slow-moving vehicle emblem?
questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem are traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: When you get in a car to drive, what should you adjust first?
questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: Which traffic light means you should stop, yield to others, and then proceed when it is safe?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is not used as a traffic signal
It means the same thing as a yellow traffic light
It means you can turn in the direction shown
It means a green arrow is coming next

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow traffic light
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow light. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph could take up to ____ to stop completely.
questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Large tractor-trailers need much more distance to stop than smaller cars. A fully loaded tractor-trailer at 55 mph may need almost 400 feet to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, what should you do?

options.text: Rely on road signs to guide you.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
Just know the general direction of your destination.
Always take the shortest route available.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before driving to an unfamiliar area. Do not start driving with only a vague idea of where you are going. Check a map to find your destination before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time from different roads. Which vehicle must yield?
questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left.
questions.explanation: At any intersection, when two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. This applies to both controlled and uncontrolled intersections.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your body weight. Physical fitness does not affect your BAC.
